[SWS_DM_01208] Authentication State Change Notifier
⌈
If the applica-
tion calls the method ara::diag::ClientAuthentication::SetNotifier of
the class ara::diag::ClientAuthentication, the Diagnostic Server in-
stance shall call the passed notifier-function whenever there is a change in the Au-
thentication State of the client.
